integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained. Arbitrary Euclidean pullbacks are reduced by exact sign averaging, the resulting diagonal problem is solved by a complete Rayleigh-quotient calculation, and the global scalar lower bound is proved algebraically. Endpoint and Cesàro consistency checks are included. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to real two-dimensional norms of the form \(N_{a,b,c}(x,y)=\sqrt{a x^2+2b|xy|+c y^2}\) with \(a,c>0\) and \(0\le b\le\sqrt{ac}\). No claim is made for higher-dimensional maxima of quadratic forms or arbitrary absolute normalized norms. An equivalent older convex-body formulation remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact Euclidean distortion of absolute piecewise-Hilbertian planes
